seed: Prefer the simplest stateless rule set. Treat every object type that never changes in the data as static scenery and model only the types that change.

synth.notes:
Two mirror axes (h row R, v col C) on 21x21 grid of 3x3 blocks; A5 cycles h->v->pieces (bbox x,y order)->h; A1-A4 move selection one block (h ignores A3/A4, v ignores A1/A2; pieces bounded, no piece overlap).
Pieces reflect across v as visible gray, across h and both as invisible occluders (hide frames; their holes show targets).
Layered composite piece>vref>iref>target>wall: first solid wins at centres (target, selected wall 0), else the topmost sprite's fill (selected piece 0, vref 4); 0 cells owned by left neighbour.
Re-extract 4-conn comps; wall_h iff bbox h>w; walls rank with piece-owned 0s, pieces with wall-owned 0s, reflections with invisible comps; targets merged at bbox gap<=3.
Unconfirmed: piece cycle order, piece-vs-piece blocking, clicks/ACTION7 (no-ops). Fully stateless.
